value.rationale: The first and vertex-minimal nontrivial stacking of a simplex-boundary five-sphere converts a simply connected double into one with five commuting essential loops; unlike the known free-group five-sphere double, this specifies a distinct and naturally motivated π1 type and full integral homology. It isolates a sharp single-stacking topology transition relevant to recently introduced r-tupling.
